text: I got a smaller and much less romantic test later. Bee gave me some shoes to try that didn’t fit. I wore them for a day, and somehow my knee ended up messed up for about a month. She did nurse me, but a bit reluctantly. She also kept suggesting it was partly in my head, or not really that bad. I get why, since neither of us could believe one day in the wrong shoes could do that. It still felt dismissive, though, like part of her just wanted my knee to be fine.
section: Loved when you stop being useful
reader: Someone wondering whether a partner would stay when they stop being useful.
